asset: Sfondo del pulsante Presentazione del corso
prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Asset type: background image for the first chapter button in a university course slide index, not a complete slide or a UI screenshot.
Primary request: create an editorial geometric illustration about visual communication and interface design, presenting a course as a connected learning journey.
Scene/backdrop: solid deep indigo #432DD7 background.
Subject: on the right, a compact composition of abstract browser panels, a page grid, and connected routes with circular stops, referring to learning, visual design, and human-computer interaction. Use a few clear forms that remain recognizable in a small horizontal banner.
Style/medium: crisp flat geometric editorial print illustration, coordinated with a Swiss-modernist course booklet and its metro-route motif. Restrained, confident composition with clean edges.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape banner, 3:1. Keep the left two thirds almost entirely quiet indigo with only faint indigo-tone routes; the existing white button title will be overlaid there in code. Concentrate the visual subject in the far right third, with details near the vertical center so it can crop to a shallower banner.
Color palette: indigo #432DD7 dominates, darker indigo #3222A3, periwinkle #615FFF, pale lavender #EEECFF, and small yellow #FDC700 selection accents.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, slogans, logos, watermark, people, faces, photographic texture, gradients, shadows, 3D gloss, or decorative sparkles. The subject should be embedded into the indigo background, with generous negative space. Do not draw a button, a slide border, or surrounding application UI.
